title: 2022 Rate-Hike Bear Market (Historical)
description: Benchmarked against actual full-year 2022 returns during the Federal Reserve's fastest rate-hiking cycle in four decades (+525 basis points, March 2022 to July 2023). These are real, dated asset returns, not an assumption — see docs/research/2022-rate-hike-selloff.md for the full per-asset source list.
transmission: Federal Reserve raises rates 525bps over the fastest hiking cycle in four decades
Discount rates rise sharply, compressing growth and technology valuations
Long-duration bonds suffer their worst year on record; risk assets sell off broadly
